intent.raw_query: Nepal trekking Annapurna, $2000 solo, October 2026, 14 days

experiences.name: Annapurna Base Camp Trek
experiences.description: Embark on the iconic multi-day trek to Annapurna Base Camp at 4,130m, passing through rhododendron forests, traditional Gurung villages, and dramatic mountain landscapes with stunning views of Annapurna I, Machapuchare, and Hiunchuli peaks.

experiences.name: Poon Hill Sunrise Hike
experiences.description: Hike to Poon Hill viewpoint at 3,210m for one of the most breathtaking panoramic sunrise views in the Himalayas, overlooking the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges bathed in golden light. A rewarding 2-day side trek from Ghorepani.
experiences.location: Ghorepani, Poon Hill, Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Gurung Village Cultural Homestay
experiences.description: Stay overnight in a traditional Gurung ethnic village, experiencing authentic Nepali mountain culture, local cuisine including dal bhat and momo dumplings, traditional dance, and stories of Himalayan life from local families who have lived here for generations.

experiences.name: Mardi Himal Trek
experiences.description: Explore the lesser-known Mardi Himal trekking route, a hidden gem offering pristine wilderness, dense forests of oak and rhododendron, and spectacular close-up views of Machapuchare (Fishtail Mountain) with far fewer crowds than the main Annapurna circuit.
experiences.location: Mardi Himal, Eastern Annapurna Conservation Area

experiences.name: Pokhara Lakeside Nature Walk and Paragliding Viewpoint
experiences.description: Explore the serene Phewa Lake shoreline and surrounding forested hills on foot, visiting the World Peace Pagoda with panoramic Himalayan views. Optionally watch paragliders launch from Sarangkot hill while enjoying fresh local tea and snacks at a lakeside cafe.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Annapurna, Nepal
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight arrives at 13:00
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu at 13:00. Clear customs, exchange currency at the airport (better rates in town but convenient here). Take a local bus or shared taxi to Pokhara (tourist bus ~$8–10) or arrange a pre-booked seat. Settle into Aegean Bliss Resort in the Annapurna region upon arrival in the late afternoon. Rest and acclimatize.
day_by_day.evening: Short stroll around the local area near the resort to get oriented. Visit a nearby lakeside or bazaar area if energy allows. Pick up any last-minute trekking supplies from local shops.

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight or airport snack
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or momos at a local dhaba near the bus station (~$2–3)
meals.dinner: Dinner at a budget Nepali restaurant near the resort — try dal bhat set meal (~$3–4)

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is primarily a travel and arrival day. Do not overexert. Drink plenty of water and avoid alcohol to help with acclimatization. Keep your trekking permits (ACAP and TIMS) in mind — purchase them in Pokhara before heading to trails.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning visit to the ACAP (Annapurna Conservation Area Project) office and TIMS (Trekkers' Information Management System) counter in Pokhara to obtain trekking permits (~$30 total). Explore Lakeside (Baidam) area, browse trekking gear shops for any missing equipment — rent trekking poles if needed (~$1–2/day).
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara (~$7 entry) — learn about Himalayan peaks, mountaineering history, and local culture. Excellent preparation for the trek ahead. Head to Phewa Lake and take a short rowboat ride (~$3–4/hour) to the Tal Barahi Temple on the island.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along Lakeside promenade. Watch the sunset over Phewa Lake with views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain) and Annapurna range. Pack your trekking bag for an early start tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Tibetan bread with honey and tea at a local bakery (~$2)
meals.lunch: Nepali thali at a local restaurant in Lakeside (~$3–4)
meals.dinner: Vegetable curry and rice at a budget restaurant near the resort (~$3–4)

day_by_day.notes: Ensure permits are secured today before heading to the trailhead. Carry photocopies of your passport and permits. The ACAP permit costs ~$20 and TIMS card ~$10 for individual trekkers.

day_by_day.morning: Early start — take a local bus or taxi from Pokhara to Nayapul trailhead (~1.5 hours, $2–3 by local bus). Begin the Annapurna Circuit / Poon Hill trek. Trek from Nayapul to Tikhedhunga (~3–4 hours, 7 km). The trail follows the Modi Khola river through terraced fields and small villages.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Tikhedhunga and check into a basic teahouse (~$3–5/night for a room). Rest and explore the village. Visit the nearby waterfall for a refreshing break. Chat with fellow trekkers and locals.
day_by_day.evening: Gather in the teahouse common area for warmth and camaraderie. Review tomorrow's route on a map. Enjoy the peaceful mountain village atmosphere as stars emerge over the Himalayas.

meals.breakfast: Porridge or eggs with tea at the resort before departure (~$2)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or noodle soup at a teahouse in Hile (~$3–4)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Tikhedhunga teahouse — the classic trekker's meal with unlimited refills (~$4–5)

day_by_day.notes: October is peak trekking season — trails will be busy but weather is excellent. Start early to avoid afternoon clouds. Wear layers as temperature drops significantly at altitude. Carry at least 2 liters of water.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tikhedhunga to Ghorepani (~5–6 hours, 10 km with significant elevation gain). Climb the famous stone staircase through rhododendron and oak forests. Pass through Ulleri village — a steep but rewarding climb of 3,000+ stone steps.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Ghorepani (2,874 m / 9,429 ft). Check into a teahouse (~$3–5/night). Rest and acclimatize. Explore the village and interact with local Magar and Gurung communities. Visit the small shops and warm up by the fire.
day_by_day.evening: Early dinner and early bedtime — tomorrow requires a 4:30 AM wake-up for the Poon Hill sunrise. Organize warm layers and headlamp for the pre-dawn hike. The temperature at this altitude drops to near freezing at night.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Tikhedhunga teahouse (~$2–3)
meals.lunch: Garlic soup and bread at a teahouse along the trail (~$3)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Ghorepani teahouse (~$4–5)

day_by_day.notes: This is one of the most strenuous days of the trek. Pace yourself on the Ulleri climb. Altitude sickness is unlikely at this elevation but stay hydrated. Ghorepani has multiple teahouses — book ahead or arrive by 2 PM during peak season.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up at 4:30 AM and hike 45 minutes to Poon Hill viewpoint (3,210 m / 10,531 ft) by headlamp. Watch the spectacular sunrise over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges — one of Nepal's most iconic views. Machhapuchhre, Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, and Dhaulagiri I all visible. Poon Hill entry fee ~$2. Return to Ghorepani for breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Trek from Ghorepani to Tadapani (~4–5 hours, 9 km) through dense rhododendron forest. The trail offers continuous mountain views. Arrive in Tadapani (2,630 m) and check into a teahouse. Enjoy views of Machhapuchhre and Annapurna from the village.
day_by_day.evening: Relax on the teahouse terrace with panoramic mountain views. Journal your experiences and take in the golden hour light on the Himalayas. Socialize with other trekkers over hot lemon tea.

meals.breakfast: Eggs, toast, and tea after returning from Poon Hill (~$3)
meals.lunch: Noodle soup or fried rice at a teahouse en route (~$3–4)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or pasta at Tadapani teahouse (~$4–5)

day_by_day.notes: The Poon Hill sunrise is the highlight of the Ghorepani-Poon Hill circuit. Bring all warm layers — it is very cold before dawn. The entry fee to Poon Hill is collected at the gate. Carry snacks for the morning hike.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tadapani to Chhomrong (~4–5 hours, 8 km). Descend through forests and cross the Kimrong Khola river. The trail passes through Gurung villages with traditional stone houses. Views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli are stunning throughout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Chhomrong (2,170 m / 7,119 ft), a beautiful Gurung village and the gateway to the Annapurna Sanctuary. Check into a teahouse (~$3–5). Explore the village, visit the small gompa (monastery), and enjoy the terraced fields and mountain backdrop.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the sunset views from Chhomrong — one of the best viewpoints on the trek. The village has slightly better facilities including hot showers (~$2 extra). Treat yourself after a long trekking day.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Tadapani teahouse (~$2–3)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at a teahouse in Kimrong (~$3–4)
meals.dinner: Vegetable curry with rice and garlic soup at Chhomrong teahouse (~$4–5)

day_by_day.notes: Garlic soup is highly recommended at altitude — locals believe it helps with acclimatization. Chhomrong is the last major resupply point before the Annapurna Sanctuary. Stock up on snacks and check your gear.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chhomrong to Dovan (~5–6 hours, 10 km). Descend to Chhomrong Khola and re-ascend to Sinuwa, then continue through bamboo and rhododendron forest to Bamboo and onward to Dovan. The forest is dense and atmospheric — watch for Himalayan wildlife including langur monkeys and colorful birds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive in Dovan (2,600 m). Check into a basic teahouse — facilities become more basic beyond Chhomrong. Rest and acclimatize. The trail beyond this point enters the Annapurna Sanctuary and is subject to avalanche risk in certain seasons — October is generally safe.
day_by_day.evening: Quiet evening in the forest setting. Listen to the sounds of the mountain streams. The sky is extraordinarily clear at this altitude — excellent stargazing. Early bedtime to prepare for tomorrow's push toward Machhapuchhre Base Camp.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and tea at Chhomrong before departure (~$3)
meals.lunch: Noodle soup at Bamboo teahouse (~$3–4)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat at Dovan teahouse (~$4–5)

day_by_day.notes: Teahouses become more basic and expensive beyond Chhomrong due to the remote location. Expect to pay slightly more for food and accommodation (~$5–7/night for rooms). Carry cash as there are no ATMs beyond Pokhara.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Dovan to Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC) (~5–6 hours, 10 km). Pass through Himalaya Hotel and Deurali, entering the dramatic glacial valley. The landscape becomes increasingly alpine and otherworldly. Snow-capped peaks tower on all sides as you enter the Annapurna Sanctuary bowl.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Machhapuchhre Base Camp (3,700 m / 12,139 ft). The sacred Fishtail Mountain (Machhapuchhre) looms directly above — it has never been officially summited. Check into a teahouse. Rest and acclimatize — altitude sickness symptoms should be monitored carefully here.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the alpenglow turn the surrounding peaks pink and gold at sunset. The Annapurna Sanctuary at dusk is one of the most breathtaking sights in the world. Stay warm — temperatures drop well below freezing. Drink plenty of fluids.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and hot tea at Dovan (~$3)
meals.lunch: Garlic soup and bread at Himalaya Hotel teahouse (~$4)
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or pasta at MBC teahouse (~$6–7 — prices rise at altitude)

day_by_day.notes: Altitude sickness is a real concern at MBC. Monitor for headache, nausea, and dizziness. The golden rule: if symptoms worsen, descend immediately. Drink 3–4 liters of water daily. Diamox (acetazolamide) can help if prescribed by a doctor before the trip.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning hike from MBC to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) (4,130 m / 13,549 ft) — approximately 2–3 hours. The trail crosses moraines and glacial terrain. Arrive at ABC surrounded by a 360-degree amphitheater of eight peaks over 7,000 m including Annapurna I (8,091 m), the 10th highest mountain in the world.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend time at ABC exploring the base camp area, taking photographs, and absorbing the magnificent views. Visit the memorial wall honoring climbers who lost their lives on Annapurna. This is the highest point of the trek — a profound achievement. Begin descent back to MBC in the afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Return to MBC for the night. Celebrate reaching ABC with fellow trekkers. The descent will have boosted your energy and reduced altitude effects. Warm dinner and well-deserved rest.

meals.breakfast: Hot porridge and tea at MBC before dawn departure (~$3–4)
meals.lunch: Snacks and energy bars carried from lower teahouses at ABC
meals.dinner: Dal bhat or noodle soup at MBC teahouse (~$6–7)

day_by_day.notes: This is the climax of the trek — Annapurna Base Camp. October weather is generally stable and clear. Start the hike to ABC by 6–7 AM to ensure clear views before afternoon clouds build. The descent from ABC to MBC takes about 1.5 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Descend from MBC back toward Bamboo (~5–6 hours). The descent is rapid — knees will feel the strain on the steep sections. Use trekking poles. Pass back through Dovan and Himalaya Hotel, enjoying the increasingly lush vegetation as you lose altitude.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue descent to Bamboo or push on to Sinuwa depending on energy levels. The rhododendron and bamboo forests feel welcoming after days above the treeline. Birdwatching opportunities are excellent on the descent.
day_by_day.evening: Settle into a teahouse at Bamboo or Sinuwa. Hot shower if available. Enjoy the warmer temperatures compared to the last few nights. Reflect on the incredible journey to ABC.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and tea at MBC before descent (~$4)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat at Himalaya Hotel or Dovan teahouse (~$4–5)
meals.dinner: Vegetable curry and rice at Bamboo teahouse (~$4–5)

day_by_day.notes: Descents are hard on the knees — take it slow and use poles. Trekking tape or knee supports are helpful. You will notice significantly improved breathing and energy as you descend from altitude. Stay hydrated even on the descent.

day_by_day.morning: Continue descent from Bamboo/Sinuwa back to Chhomrong (~3–4 hours). The trail climbs back up the famous stone staircase into Chhomrong village. Enjoy the reunion with civilization — better teahouses, more food options, and hot showers.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rest in Chhomrong. Take a well-earned hot shower. Visit the local village and interact with Gurung families. Explore the terraced fields and enjoy the dramatic views of Annapurna South one more time. Optional: visit the small local school if open.
day_by_day.evening: Celebratory dinner with fellow trekkers at a Chhomrong teahouse. Share stories from the ABC trek. The atmosphere in Chhomrong is always lively during peak season. Early night for the long descent tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Porridge and tea at Bamboo/Sinuwa teahouse (~$3)
meals.lunch: Garlic soup and bread along the trail (~$3)
meals.dinner: Special dinner — try apple pie or yak cheese pizza at a Chhomrong teahouse (~$5–6)

day_by_day.notes: Chhomrong marks the psychological return to comfort after the high-altitude section. Many trekkers spend an extra rest day here. The apple products (pie, juice, raksi) at Chhomrong are locally famous and delicious.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chhomrong back toward Nayapul via Jhinu Danda (~4–5 hours). Stop at Jhinu Danda for a soak in the famous natural hot springs (~$3 entry) — a perfect reward for tired muscles after days of trekking. The springs sit beside the Modi Khola river.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Jhinu Danda to Nayapul (~3–4 hours). The trail descends through forests and villages back to the trailhead. Catch a local bus or taxi back to Pokhara (~1.5 hours, $2–3 by bus). Return to the Aegean Bliss Resort area.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate the completion of the Annapurna trek with a lakeside dinner in Pokhara. Enjoy a proper restaurant meal — you have earned it! Stroll along Lakeside and enjoy the buzz of the tourist area after days in the mountains.

meals.breakfast: Eggs and tea at Chhomrong teahouse (~$3)
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or noodle soup at a teahouse near Jhinu Danda (~$3–4)
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at a Lakeside restaurant — try Newari cuisine or continental food (~$6–8)

day_by_day.notes: The Jhinu Danda hot springs are a highlight — plan to spend at least 1–2 hours there. Bring a towel and change of clothes. The springs are open from early morning to evening. This is one of the best natural hot spring experiences in Nepal.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day in Pokhara. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast. Visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) — hike up or take a boat across Phewa Lake and walk up (~1.5 hours one way). Stunning panoramic views of Pokhara, the lake, and the Annapurna range.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave near Davis Falls — a sacred cave with a Shiva shrine and underground waterfall (~$1.50 entry). Explore the Tibetan refugee settlement at Tashiling and browse handmade Tibetan crafts and carpets. Support local artisans by purchasing small souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset views from the Lakeside promenade. Browse local shops for trekking souvenirs, thangka paintings, and handicrafts. Enjoy a relaxed evening with a cold Everest beer or fresh fruit juice at a lakeside café.

meals.breakfast: Full breakfast at a Lakeside café — eggs, toast, fresh juice (~$4–5)
meals.lunch: Momos (dumplings) and butter tea at a Tibetan restaurant (~$3–4)
meals.dinner: Thakali set meal at a local restaurant — authentic Mustang cuisine (~$5–6)

day_by_day.notes: This is a well-deserved rest day after the strenuous trek. Let your body recover. Do laundry (many guesthouses offer laundry service for ~$1–2/kg). Charge all devices. Back up your photos. Organize your gear for the return journey.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the Annapurna region. Early sunrise walk to a viewpoint for one last look at the Annapurna range. Pack all belongings and check out of the resort. Take a final walk through Lakeside market for any last-minute souvenirs — bargain respectfully.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrange transport back to Kathmandu — tourist bus (~$8–10, 7–8 hours) or domestic flight (~$80–100, 25 minutes) depending on budget and departure schedule. If flying back, arrive at Pokhara Airport early. If busing, enjoy the scenic Prithvi Highway journey along rivers and gorges.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive in Kathmandu. Explore Thamel neighborhood if time permits — vibrant backpacker hub with restaurants, shops, and street food. Final dinner in Nepal before any onward travel. Reflect on an incredible 14-day Himalayan adventure.

meals.breakfast: Final Nepali breakfast — sel roti (rice doughnut) with tea at a local bakery (~$2)
meals.lunch: Snacks and packed food for the journey or airport meal (~$3–5)
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner in Thamel, Kathmandu — try a rooftop restaurant with mountain views (~$6–8)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm all onward transport bookings the night before. Keep essential documents (passport, permits, insurance) easily accessible. Nepal's domestic flights are subject to weather delays — have a backup plan. Budget approximately $300–400 total for the 14-day trip excluding international flights, covering accommodation, food, permits, and local transport.

trip_options.title: Classic Annapurna, Nepal Experience
trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at airport at 13:00 - no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Pokhara/Annapurna region, transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and take a gentle orientation walk around the resort grounds and nearby lakeside or village area to get your bearings and acclimatize
day_by_day.evening: Relax at the resort, enjoy the mountain views at sunset over the Annapurna range, stroll along the local area and explore nearby shops for trekking essentials

meals.breakfast: Meal on the flight or at the airport
meals.lunch: Light snack or dal bhat at a local teahouse near the resort upon arrival
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at the resort restaurant or a nearby mid-range restaurant such as Moosehead Restaurant or OR2K in Pokhara - try traditional Nepali thali set

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 light due to travel fatigue. Ensure trekking permits (TIMS card and Annapurna Conservation Area Permit) are arranged either online in advance or first thing tomorrow morning in Pokhara. Stay hydrated and avoid alcohol on arrival night.

day_by_day.morning: Visit the Annapurna Conservation Area Project (ACAP) office in Pokhara to obtain trekking permits if not already secured. Explore Pokhara's Lakeside (Phewa Lake) area, take a short rowboat ride on Phewa Lake with views of Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain)
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) via a short hike or boat ride across Phewa Lake - offers panoramic views of the Annapurna massif and Pokhara valley. Explore the Devi's Fall waterfall and Gupteshwor Mahadev Cave nearby
day_by_day.evening: Browse the Lakeside bazaar for last-minute trekking gear, warm layers, and snacks. Enjoy a relaxed evening preparing gear for the trek starting tomorrow

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort - eggs, toast, and tea/coffee
meals.lunch: Lunch at a lakeside café such as Busy Bee Café - try pasta or a sandwich with lake views
meals.dinner: Dinner at Caffe Concerto or a similar mid-range lakeside restaurant - try grilled trout or momos (dumplings)

day_by_day.notes: October is peak trekking season in Annapurna - expect clear skies and excellent mountain views. Carry a daypack with water, sunscreen, and a light jacket. Confirm your trekking route with your guide or hotel staff today.

day_by_day.morning: Drive or take a jeep from Pokhara to Nayapul (approximately 1.5 hours). Begin the classic Annapurna Circuit or Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) trek. Trek from Nayapul to Tikhedhunga (approximately 4-5 hours, 1,540m elevation) through terraced fields and small Gurung villages
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking through rhododendron and oak forests. Arrive at Tikhedhunga teahouse village. Rest and explore the local stone-paved village lanes
day_by_day.evening: Settle into a mid-range teahouse lodge. Enjoy views of the Modi Khola river gorge. Rest legs and review tomorrow's route with other trekkers

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before departure - porridge, eggs, and tea
meals.lunch: Dal bhat or noodle soup at a teahouse along the trail near Birethanti
meals.dinner: Dinner at your Tikhedhunga teahouse lodge - dal bhat, vegetable curry, or pasta

day_by_day.notes: Wear broken-in trekking boots from Day 1. Carry at least 2 liters of water. The trail from Nayapul involves a gradual ascent. Tikhedhunga features a large waterfall nearby worth a short visit before dinner. Teahouse accommodation is basic but comfortable at mid-range lodges.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning start from Tikhedhunga. Climb the famous 3,000+ stone steps to Ulleri village (1,960m) - a challenging but rewarding ascent through dense forest with Himalayan views. Trek onward through Banthanti to Ghorepani (2,860m)
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghorepani by early afternoon (total trekking time approximately 5-6 hours). Check into a teahouse lodge. Rest and acclimatize to the higher altitude
day_by_day.evening: Explore Ghorepani village, a popular hub for trekkers. Watch the alpenglow on Dhaulagiri and Annapurna South at dusk. Socialize with fellow trekkers in the teahouse common room

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at Tikhedhunga teahouse - porridge with honey, boiled eggs, and black tea
meals.lunch: Lunch stop at Banthanti teahouse - garlic soup (excellent for altitude), fried rice or noodles
meals.dinner: Dinner at Ghorepani teahouse - hearty dal bhat with seasonal vegetables and lentil soup

day_by_day.notes: The ascent to Ulleri is steep and demanding - take it slow and steady. Drink garlic soup at lunch as it is believed to help with altitude acclimatization. Ghorepani sits at nearly 2,900m so mild altitude symptoms (headache, fatigue) are possible - rest well and stay hydrated.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn wake-up (around 4:30-5:00 AM) for the 45-minute hike to Poon Hill (3,210m) to witness one of Nepal's most spectacular sunrises over the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Watch golden light illuminate Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Machhapuchhre, and Dhaulagiri
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend back to Ghorepani for breakfast then trek onward to Tadapani (2,630m) through dense rhododendron forests - approximately 4-5 hours of trekking with excellent ridge-top Himalayan views
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Tadapani. Relax at the teahouse. Enjoy expansive views of Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre from the village clearing

meals.breakfast: Post-Poon Hill breakfast at Ghorepani teahouse - pancakes, eggs, and milk tea
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or teahouse stop en route to Tadapani - noodle soup or fried rice
meals.dinner: Dinner at Tadapani teahouse - pasta, vegetable curry, or Sherpa stew

day_by_day.notes: Poon Hill is the undisputed highlight of the lower Annapurna region - bring a warm fleece and gloves as it is very cold before sunrise at 3,200m. Carry a headlamp for the pre-dawn hike. The rhododendron forest between Ghorepani and Tadapani is stunning even in October with autumn foliage.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Tadapani to Chhomrong (2,170m) - approximately 5-6 hours through forests and across suspension bridges over the Modi Khola. Chhomrong is a large, scenic Gurung village and the gateway to the Annapurna Sanctuary
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Chhomrong. Explore the terraced Gurung village with its traditional stone houses, mani walls, and prayer flags. Visit the local cheese factory if open
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy sweeping views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli from Chhomrong's elevated terraces. Rest and prepare for the more demanding days ahead toward ABC

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at Tadapani teahouse - muesli with warm milk, toast with peanut butter
meals.lunch: Teahouse lunch en route - dal bhat or spring rolls at a midway stop
meals.dinner: Dinner at a Chhomrong lodge such as Excellent View Lodge - try the local apple cider and a warm vegetable curry

day_by_day.notes: Chhomrong involves a steep descent and re-ascent with stone staircases. Trekking poles are highly recommended from this point onward. Stock up on chocolate, energy bars, and snacks in Chhomrong as prices increase significantly beyond this point. Ensure permits are checked at the ACAP checkpoint here.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chhomrong down to Sinuwa and then through the bamboo and rhododendron forest to Bamboo (2,310m) and onward to Dovan (2,600m) - approximately 5 hours of trekking through increasingly dramatic gorge scenery
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking from Dovan to Himalaya Hotel (2,920m) through dense forest with occasional views of the towering walls of the Annapurna Sanctuary entrance. Arrive by early afternoon
day_by_day.evening: Rest at Himalaya Hotel teahouse. The forest here is home to Himalayan Thar and langur monkeys - keep an eye out at dusk. Temperatures drop noticeably - layer up

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at Chhomrong lodge - eggs any style, toast, and black tea
meals.lunch: Lunch at Bamboo or Dovan teahouse - garlic soup, fried noodles, or dal bhat
meals.dinner: Dinner at Himalaya Hotel teahouse - dal bhat or pasta with tomato sauce

day_by_day.notes: The trail enters the Annapurna Sanctuary gorge today - the canyon walls are dramatic and the forest is pristine. There is a risk of avalanche in certain sections after snowfall - check conditions with your guide. Temperatures can drop to near freezing at night at this altitude - a warm sleeping bag liner is useful.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Himalaya Hotel to Machhapuchhre Base Camp (MBC, 3,700m) - approximately 4-5 hours through increasingly alpine terrain as the forest gives way to open moraine. The iconic Fishtail peak dominates the skyline
day_by_day.afternoon: From MBC, continue the final push to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC, 4,130m) - approximately 2 more hours. The sanctuary opens up into a dramatic glacial amphitheater ringed by Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Hiunchuli, Gangapurna, and Machhapuchhre
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate reaching ABC. Watch the spectacular sunset alpenglow on the surrounding 7,000m and 8,000m peaks. The silence and scale of the Annapurna Sanctuary at dusk is unforgettable

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at Himalaya Hotel - porridge, boiled eggs, and hot lemon tea
meals.lunch: Quick lunch at MBC teahouse - hot noodle soup, hot chocolate, and energy snacks
meals.dinner: Dinner at ABC lodge - dal bhat or pasta; treat yourself to a hot chocolate or apple cider to celebrate

day_by_day.notes: ABC at 4,130m is the highest point of this itinerary. Altitude sickness is a real concern - ascend slowly, drink 3-4 liters of water daily, avoid alcohol, and descend immediately if you experience severe headache, vomiting, or loss of coordination. October weather at ABC is generally clear and cold with temperatures dropping to -5°C to -10°C at night. Carry all warm layers.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn alarm for the sunrise at ABC - one of the world's great mountain sunrise experiences as the first light turns Annapurna I and surrounding peaks golden pink. Spend the morning exploring the base camp area and glacial moraine
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin descent from ABC back to Bamboo (2,310m) - a long but mostly downhill day of approximately 6-7 hours through MBC and the sanctuary gorge. The descent is much faster than the ascent
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Bamboo teahouse. Legs will be tired - do gentle stretches. Celebrate the successful ABC summit with fellow trekkers

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at ABC lodge after sunrise - porridge, eggs, and hot tea
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or quick stop at MBC or Dovan - noodle soup or fried rice
meals.dinner: Dinner at Bamboo teahouse - dal bhat with unlimited rice refills (a trekker's best friend after a long day)

day_by_day.notes: The descent from 4,130m to 2,310m in one day is demanding on the knees - use trekking poles and take regular breaks. The change in air pressure as you descend often provides an immediate energy boost. Bamboo teahouses are basic but adequate. Celebrate with a well-deserved Everest beer or Tongba (hot millet wine) this evening.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Bamboo back up to Chhomrong (approximately 4-5 hours with a significant re-ascent of the stone staircases). The return journey through the bamboo and rhododendron forest offers a different perspective
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive back in Chhomrong. Rest, shower (hot showers available at mid-range lodges), and do laundry. Explore any parts of the Gurung village you missed on the way up
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a well-earned rest in Chhomrong. Dine with a view of Annapurna South glowing at sunset. Reflect on the incredible journey to ABC

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at Bamboo teahouse - pancakes with honey and hot milk tea
meals.lunch: Teahouse lunch en route at Sinuwa - garlic soup and fried noodles
meals.dinner: Dinner at Chhomrong lodge - splurge slightly on a good meal such as buff (buffalo) steak or yak cheese pizza at one of the better lodges

day_by_day.notes: The re-ascent to Chhomrong via the stone steps is tiring on already-fatigued legs - pace yourself. Chhomrong has the best facilities since leaving Pokhara including hot showers, phone charging, and a wider menu. Treat yourself to a warm shower and a slightly more indulgent meal tonight.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Chhomrong back to Ghorepani via Tadapani - a scenic ridge route through rhododendron forests with continuing Himalayan views (approximately 6 hours). This is a classic high traverse with excellent panoramic scenery
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Ghorepani. Rest at the teahouse. Optional short walk to the ridge above the village for afternoon views of Dhaulagiri
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy your last night in the high mountains at Ghorepani. The village has a lively trekker atmosphere with several good teahouse restaurants. Share stories with other trekkers

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at Chhomrong - eggs, toast, and fruit salad
meals.lunch: Teahouse lunch at Tadapani - dal bhat or vegetable fried rice
meals.dinner: Dinner at Ghorepani teahouse - try the apple pie which this region is famous for, alongside a main of pasta or curry

day_by_day.notes: This is a long trekking day through varied terrain. The Chhomrong to Tadapani section involves some steep ascents. Carry plenty of water and snacks. Ghorepani's teahouses are among the best on the circuit with good food and comfortable dorm or private rooms.

day_by_day.morning: Optional second sunrise hike to Poon Hill (recommended if weather is different from Day 5 or if you want a final mountain farewell). Alternatively, enjoy a leisurely breakfast and begin the descent to Nayapul via Ulleri and Tikhedhunga (approximately 5-6 hours)
day_by_day.afternoon: Complete the descent to Nayapul through terraced farmland and Magar villages. Arrange jeep or local bus transfer back to Pokhara (approximately 1.5 hours). Return to Aegean Bliss Resort
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate completing the Annapurna trek. Enjoy the resort facilities - hot shower, comfortable bed, and a proper restaurant meal. Explore Pokhara's Lakeside area for souvenir shopping

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at Ghorepani teahouse - muesli, eggs, and milk tea
meals.lunch: Final trail lunch at Tikhedhunga or Birethanti teahouse - dal bhat or noodle soup
meals.dinner: Celebratory dinner at a Lakeside restaurant in Pokhara such as Dwarika's or a rooftop restaurant - try a proper Nepali set meal with raksi (local spirit) or a cold Everest beer

day_by_day.notes: The descent from Ghorepani to Nayapul is long but straightforward. Your knees will feel the 3,000+ stone steps down from Ulleri - trekking poles essential. Upon returning to Pokhara, indulge in the creature comforts you have missed - hot shower, clean clothes, and a varied restaurant menu.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery day in Pokhara. Enjoy a slow morning at the resort. Optional visit to the International Mountain Museum in Pokhara - excellent exhibits on Himalayan mountaineering history, Nepali cultures, and the geology of the Himalayas
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a peaceful kayak or paddleboat ride on Phewa Lake. Visit the Barahi Temple on the island in the middle of the lake. Alternatively, enjoy a relaxing massage at one of Pokhara's many affordable wellness centers to soothe trekking-tired muscles
day_by_day.evening: Sunset stroll along the Lakeside promenade. Browse handicraft shops for Thangka paintings, pashmina scarves, singing bowls, and trekking mementos. Enjoy a final evening in the Annapurna region

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast - fresh fruit, eggs, toast, yogurt, and Nepali tea
meals.lunch: Lunch at a Lakeside café - try the famous Pokhara trout or a wood-fired pizza at a mid-range café
meals.dinner: Dinner at a highly-rated Lakeside restaurant - try Nepali-fusion cuisine or a traditional Newari meal with beaten rice, black lentils, and fermented vegetables

day_by_day.notes: Day 13 is intentionally relaxed to allow physical recovery before the return journey. A traditional Nepali massage (approximately 1,500-2,500 NPR at mid-range spas) is highly recommended for sore muscles. The International Mountain Museum is one of the best in Asia and costs approximately 300 NPR entry.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the Annapurna region. Early wake-up for a last sunrise view of the Annapurna range from Pokhara - the view of the entire Annapurna massif reflected in Phewa Lake at dawn is iconic. Take a final walk along the lakeside
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Depending on departure flight time, visit any remaining Pokhara sights such as the Seti River Gorge viewpoint or the Old Bazaar area. Transfer to Pokhara Airport or Kathmandu for onward flights
day_by_day.evening: Departure or overnight in Kathmandu if connecting flight requires. If time permits in Kathmandu, visit Thamel neighborhood for last-minute shopping or a farewell dinner

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at the resort - enjoy a full spread and savor the last mountain views
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the airport café or a Lakeside restaurant before departure - try sel roti (Nepali rice doughnut) with tea as a final local treat
meals.dinner: Airport meal or dinner in Kathmandu if overnight stop - try Thamel House Restaurant for authentic Nepali cuisine in a traditional setting

day_by_day.notes: Confirm all flight details and allow extra time for airport transfers. Domestic flights in Nepal can be delayed due to weather or mountain visibility conditions - build buffer time into your schedule. Ensure all trekking permits are returned or retained as souvenirs. Nepal's airport tax is included in most international tickets but confirm with your airline. Carry Nepali rupees for any last-minute purchases as card acceptance is limited outside major hotels.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Annapurna, Nepal Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Tribhuvan International Airport at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury transfer from Kathmandu airport to Pokhara via helicopter or premium vehicle. Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort, Annapurna. Settle into your Beachfront suite, enjoy a welcome drink and orientation tour of the resort facilities overlooking the Annapurna range.
day_by_day.evening: Leisurely sunset stroll along the Phewa Lake shoreline adjacent to the resort. Enjoy panoramic golden-hour views of the Annapurna massif and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail Mountain) reflected on the lake.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable — in-flight or airport meal
meals.lunch: Not applicable — traveling
meals.dinner: Welcome dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant featuring curated Nepali-fusion cuisine, paired with Himalayan herbal cocktails and locally sourced ingredients. Private lakeside table arrangement.

day_by_day.notes: Ensure passport, visa, and travel insurance documents are ready. Resort concierge will assist with trek permits (ACAP and TIMS) upon check-in. Acclimatization rest is recommended for the first evening. Pokhara sits at ~820m elevation.

day_by_day.morning: Private guided sunrise boat ride on Phewa Lake to the Tal Barahi Temple island. Witness the Annapurna range bathed in early morning alpenglow — one of Nepal's most iconic vistas. Return for a gourmet resort breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Guided cultural exploration of Pokhara's Old Bazaar and Bindhyabasini Temple. Visit the International Mountain Museum for an immersive premium tour covering Himalayan history, geology, and legendary expeditions. Private guide and air-conditioned vehicle provided.
day_by_day.evening: Helicopter scenic flight over the Annapurna foothills and Seti Gorge at dusk (weather permitting). Return to resort for a curated tasting menu dinner featuring Newari and Thakali delicacies.

meals.breakfast: Full gourmet Nepali and continental breakfast buffet at the resort's lakeside terrace restaurant
meals.lunch: Exclusive lunch at a premium Pokhara rooftop restaurant — try Thakali Dal Bhat set with organic highland ingredients
meals.dinner: Multi-course Newari tasting menu at the resort's fine-dining pavilion with sommelier-selected wine pairings

day_by_day.notes: Helicopter flight is subject to weather and visibility. Resort concierge will confirm by 07:00. This is also an ideal day for final gear checks before trekking begins. Premium trekking gear rental available at the resort.

day_by_day.morning: Private helicopter transfer from Pokhara to Jhinu Danda (1,780m) — a dramatic entry into the Annapurna Conservation Area. Begin a guided luxury trek along the Modi Khola river valley through terraced fields and rhododendron forests toward Chhomrong village.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Chhomrong (2,170m), a picturesque Gurung village offering sweeping views of Annapurna South and Hiunchuli. Check in to a premium teahouse lodge with private ensuite rooms. Guided village walk and interaction with local Gurung community.
day_by_day.evening: Relaxation with hot stone massage at the lodge's wellness corner. Stargazing session with the resort's provided telescope — October skies in Annapurna are exceptionally clear.

meals.breakfast: Gourmet breakfast at the resort before departure — eggs Benedict, fresh fruit, and Himalayan honey
meals.lunch: Gourmet packed lunch prepared by the resort, enjoyed at a scenic riverside stop en route
meals.dinner: Traditional Gurung feast at the premium teahouse — organic lentil soup, highland yak cheese, and freshly baked Tibetan bread

day_by_day.notes: ACAP and TIMS permits will be checked at the entry checkpoint. Trekking pace is leisurely to allow acclimatization. Porter and private guide accompany throughout. Emergency satellite phone provided.

day_by_day.morning: Early sunrise views of Annapurna South from Chhomrong viewpoint. Begin guided trek through bamboo and rhododendron forests descending to Sinuwa (2,360m) and continuing to Dovan (2,600m). Moderate trail with dramatic gorge scenery.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue trekking to Himalaya Hotel (2,920m) through dense old-growth forest. Spot Himalayan wildlife including langur monkeys, colorful pheasants, and if fortunate, red pandas. Arrive at premium lodge for check-in and hot shower.
day_by_day.evening: Guided nature journaling session with the private naturalist guide — document flora, fauna, and landscape observations. Cozy fireside relaxation at the lodge common room.

meals.breakfast: Hot porridge, eggs, and local honey at Chhomrong teahouse
meals.lunch: Gourmet packed lunch at Dovan rest point — gourmet sandwiches, energy bars, and fresh fruit
meals.dinner: Hearty mountain dinner at Himalaya Hotel lodge — garlic soup (altitude remedy), vegetable curry, and steamed momos

day_by_day.notes: Altitude increases significantly today. Hydration is critical — drink 3–4 liters of water. Diamox available if needed. Trail can be muddy; premium trekking poles and gaiters recommended. October temperatures at this altitude drop to ~5°C at night.

day_by_day.morning: Trek from Himalaya Hotel through misty forest to Deurali (3,230m). The landscape transitions to alpine zone with sparse vegetation and dramatic rock faces. Short acclimatization walk above Deurali for altitude adjustment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend slightly and continue to Machapuchare Base Camp (MBC) at 3,700m — an awe-inspiring glacial amphitheater surrounded by towering peaks. Check in to the highest premium teahouse on the route. Rest and acclimatize.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset meditation session at MBC with private guide — witness the fishtail peak of Machhapuchhre turn crimson at dusk. Hot herbal tea and warm blankets provided. Early rest for the pre-dawn start tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Warm oatmeal, Tibetan bread with yak butter, and ginger tea at Himalaya Hotel
meals.lunch: Hot soup and noodle lunch at Deurali rest stop
meals.dinner: Nutritious high-altitude dinner at MBC — lentil dal, rice, seasonal vegetables, and hot chocolate

day_by_day.notes: Altitude at MBC is 3,700m — acute mountain sickness (AMS) risk increases. Monitor for headache, nausea, or dizziness. Do not ascend further if symptoms appear. Private guide carries supplemental oxygen and first aid kit. No trekking above MBC without guide approval.

day_by_day.morning: Pre-dawn start at 04:00 — guided trek to Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) at 4,130m, arriving for one of the world's most spectacular sunrises. The entire Annapurna sanctuary — a 360-degree amphitheater of eight peaks above 7,000m — illuminates in pink and gold. Photography session with professional guide.
day_by_day.afternoon: Extended exploration of ABC — the sacred cirque surrounded by Annapurna I (8,091m), Annapurna South, Gangapurna, and Glacier Dome. Guided glacial moraine walk and peak identification session. Ceremonial offering at the base camp shrine.
day_by_day.evening: Return trek to Machapuchare Base Camp for overnight. Celebratory dinner marking the achievement of reaching ABC. Hot spring water bottle provided for warmth.

meals.breakfast: Energy bars and hot thermos tea consumed on the trail during ascent to ABC
meals.lunch: Hot noodle soup and tea at ABC teahouse — savor the achievement at 4,130m
meals.dinner: Celebration dinner at MBC — special chef-prepared meal with Himalayan herbal spirits toast

day_by_day.notes: This is the trek's highest point and greatest achievement. Weather window in October is typically excellent with clear skies. Allow extra time for photography. Descent to MBC same evening reduces overnight altitude stress. Warm layering essential — temperatures can reach -10°C at ABC.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely morning at MBC — final views of the Annapurna Sanctuary at dawn. Begin descent through Deurali and Himalaya Hotel, enjoying the reverse perspective of the dramatic gorge landscape. The descent is notably faster and easier.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue descent to Bamboo (2,310m) through lush bamboo groves and cascading waterfalls. The lower altitude brings immediate physiological relief and renewed energy. Check in to riverside teahouse.
day_by_day.evening: Natural hot spring soak at Jhinu Danda hot springs (short detour) — a perfect reward after days of high-altitude trekking. The thermal springs beside the Modi Khola river are legendary among trekkers.

meals.breakfast: Hot porridge and Tibetan bread at MBC before departure
meals.lunch: Packed gourmet lunch enjoyed at a waterfall viewpoint en route
meals.dinner: Riverside dinner at Bamboo teahouse — fresh river fish curry, seasonal greens, and warm raksi (Nepali spirit)

day_by_day.notes: Hot spring visit at Jhinu adds approximately 45 minutes to the day. Bring swimwear and a towel. Descent is on knees — trekking poles essential. Total descent today is nearly 1,400m; pace accordingly to avoid fatigue.

day_by_day.morning: Morning trek from Bamboo through Sinuwa and back to Chhomrong. The Gurung village in morning light offers beautiful photographic opportunities of terraced fields and traditional stone houses. Visit a local Gurung home for an authentic cultural exchange.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private helicopter transfer from Chhomrong/New Bridge landing zone back to Pokhara. Return to Aegean Bliss Resort — check back into your Beachfront suite. Luxury spa treatment session: Himalayan salt scrub and deep tissue massage.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails on the resort's private lakeside deck. Reflection and journaling of the Annapurna trekking experience with complimentary champagne service.

meals.breakfast: Hearty Nepali breakfast at Chhomrong teahouse — dal bhat, eggs, and fresh juice
meals.lunch: Gourmet packed lunch on the trail before helicopter pickup
meals.dinner: Celebratory fine-dining dinner at the resort — premium Nepali tasting menu with Himalayan trout, highland lamb, and artisanal desserts

day_by_day.notes: Helicopter transfer is weather-dependent; backup plan is full-day trek to Nayapul followed by private vehicle to Pokhara. Resort spa should be pre-booked by concierge on Day 7 via satellite communication. Laundry service available upon return.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning at the resort. Optional yoga and pranayama session with a private Himalayan yoga instructor on the lakeside pavilion at sunrise. Followed by a full resort breakfast and leisurely poolside relaxation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private guided day hike to the World Peace Pagoda (Shanti Stupa) above Pokhara — a moderate 2-hour hike through forest offering arguably the finest panoramic views of the entire Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Private picnic setup at the pagoda.
day_by_day.evening: Cultural evening in Pokhara — private guided tour of the Gurkha Museum followed by a premium dinner at one of Pokhara's finest restaurants with live traditional Nepali music.

meals.breakfast: Lavish resort breakfast buffet — fresh smoothies, eggs station, pastries, and Himalayan honey
meals.lunch: Gourmet private picnic at the World Peace Pagoda — artisan sandwiches, local cheeses, fruits, and sparkling water
meals.dinner: Premium dinner at a top-rated Pokhara restaurant — try the highland yak steak or Himalayan trout with organic wine

day_by_day.notes: World Peace Pagoda hike is 400m elevation gain — a pleasant active recovery after the main trek. Sunset from the pagoda is exceptional. Evening restaurant reservation should be made by concierge in advance. Dress smart-casual for dinner.

day_by_day.morning: Private guided hiking excursion to Sarangkot (1,592m) — the premier sunrise viewpoint above Pokhara offering a sweeping panorama of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri ranges. Pre-dawn departure with hot thermos tea. Optional paragliding tandem flight from Sarangkot over Phewa Lake.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort for a leisurely lunch. Afternoon at leisure — resort pool, spa, or optional kayaking on Phewa Lake with private instructor. Explore the resort's curated Himalayan art gallery.
day_by_day.evening: Private sunset cruise on Phewa Lake aboard the resort's luxury wooden boat. Champagne and canapés served on the water with mountain reflections. Return for dinner.

meals.breakfast: Pre-dawn snack before Sarangkot departure; full gourmet breakfast upon return at the resort
meals.lunch: Light gourmet lunch at the resort's poolside restaurant — fresh salads, grilled items, and tropical juices
meals.dinner: Intimate candlelit dinner on the resort's private lakeside terrace — seafood and Himalayan fusion menu

day_by_day.notes: Paragliding from Sarangkot is one of Nepal's top adventure experiences — October conditions are ideal. Flights last 20–30 minutes. Weight limit applies (typically 110kg). Book through resort concierge. Sunset cruise should be pre-arranged with resort.

day_by_day.morning: Private helicopter excursion to Mustang region or Jomsom — an extraordinary half-day scenic flight over the Kali Gandaki gorge (world's deepest gorge) and the dramatic Trans-Himalayan landscape. Land at Jomsom (2,720m) for a brief guided exploration of the ancient salt-trading town.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return helicopter flight to Pokhara. Afternoon at the resort for relaxation, spa treatments, or optional guided nature walk through the resort's surrounding forest trails to spot local bird species — Pokhara is renowned for birdwatching.
day_by_day.evening: Cooking class experience — private Nepali culinary lesson with the resort's head chef. Learn to prepare Dal Bhat, momos, and Sel Roti. Enjoy your creations for dinner.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast before helicopter departure
meals.lunch: Traditional Thakali lunch at a premium Jomsom restaurant — the authentic home of Thakali cuisine
meals.dinner: Your personally prepared Nepali feast from the cooking class, served in the resort's private dining room

day_by_day.notes: Mustang helicopter excursion requires additional permit (Upper Mustang restricted area permit ~$500 if venturing beyond Jomsom). Confirm with concierge. Jomsom is windy in the afternoon — morning flights are always preferable. Birdwatching list provided by resort naturalist.

day_by_day.morning: Private guided cultural day trip to the Ghandruk village (1,940m) — one of the most beautiful Gurung villages in Nepal with stunning Annapurna South and Hiunchuli views. Drive to Kimche and trek 1.5 hours uphill through terraced fields.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Ghandruk — visit the Gurung Museum, traditional stone-paved lanes, and interact with local weavers producing premium Dhaka fabric. Commissioned textile purchase opportunity. Trek back down and private vehicle return to Pokhara.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell pre-celebration at the resort's rooftop bar — premium cocktails crafted with Himalayan botanicals. Reflect on the journey with your private guide over drinks and light tapas.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Premium lunch at Ghandruk's finest teahouse with Annapurna panorama — local Gurung cuisine including nettle soup and millet bread
meals.dinner: Grand dinner at the resort's signature restaurant — seven-course tasting menu celebrating Nepali culinary heritage with paired wines

day_by_day.notes: Ghandruk is a UNESCO-nominated site and one of Nepal's most photogenic villages. Bring cash for textile purchases — local artisan cooperatives support community income. The drive to Kimche takes approximately 1.5 hours from Pokhara.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise experience at Phewa Lake — private guided rowing boat session at dawn. Meditative morning on the water with the Annapurna range as backdrop. Return for a leisurely final breakfast at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spa and wellness afternoon — full luxury spa package including Ayurvedic treatment, hot stone massage, and Himalayan herb steam bath. Final resort pool time and personal shopping at the resort boutique for premium Nepali souvenirs, pashmina, and thangka art.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell gala dinner at the resort — private dining setup on the beachfront terrace with personalized menu, live Nepali acoustic music, and a curated selection of Himalayan wines and spirits. Toast to an extraordinary Annapurna journey.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent final breakfast at the resort — made-to-order eggs, fresh juices, pastries, and Himalayan tea ceremony
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — mezze-style sharing plates and fresh tropical fruits
meals.dinner: Private farewell gala dinner on the beachfront — bespoke menu designed by the head chef with premium wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: Concierge should arrange airport transfer and reconfirm departure flight details today. Luggage packing assistance available. Ensure all permits, trek certificates, and souvenirs are organized. Resort can arrange certificate of trek completion as a keepsake.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning at leisure — optional last sunrise walk along the Phewa Lake shoreline. Checkout formalities handled seamlessly by resort butler service. Complimentary late checkout until 14:00 available upon request.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private luxury transfer from Aegean Bliss Resort to Pokhara Regional Airport or directly to Kathmandu Tribhuvan International Airport via premium vehicle or helicopter. Airport lounge access arranged by concierge.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — carry with you the extraordinary memories of the Annapurna Sanctuary, Himalayan sunrises, Gurung culture, and the world's most dramatic mountain landscapes.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — a grand send-off with all favorites from the past two weeks
meals.lunch: Gourmet farewell lunch box prepared by the resort chef for the journey to the airport
meals.dinner: In-flight or at Kathmandu's premium airport restaurant if connecting — try Krishnarpan at Dwarika's Hotel if overnight in Kathmandu

day_by_day.notes: Allow minimum 3 hours before international departure from Kathmandu TIA. Helicopter transfer from Pokhara to Kathmandu (~25 minutes) is far preferable to the 6-hour road journey. Ensure all permits (ACAP, TIMS) are retained as souvenirs — they make wonderful keepsakes. Tips for guide, porter, and resort staff are customary and deeply appreciated.
